reviews.title: Critically missing
reviews.text:
I really like my wallpapers but my pretty calendar becomes extremely useless and unusable.

My pretty calendar is missing the critical option to sync my gmail account??

Please add the sync and integration of our Gmail accounts???

Please fix as soon as possible. I really like to keep this pretty calendar on this app.
